title: chat_bubble
summary: MSUI now routes SAY/YELL/PARTY and monster say/yell from the resolved SMSG_MESSAGECHAT display path into one replace-never-queue bubble per live speaker. ChatBubbleUiLaw owns the separate all/party settings, plain-text pipe/color/link sanitization, exact space/tab word count, self-vs-other duration asymmetry, 250 ms recoverable range fade and permanent lifetime fade, 20 yd spawn/per-frame gate, damped diagonal sizing, and 16/1024-screen-width border. The world overlay uses Blizzard's ChatBubble Background/Backdrop/Tail art; the eight-piece backdrop uses repeat addressing and atlas-bleed inset, cards sort farthest-to-nearest so the nearest speaker stacks on top, and the seat grows upward from a projected world point. M2Reader now retains the Stand sequence CAaBox and the per-line anchor latches its model-scaled Z extent plus 0.7 yd, distinct from the posed name height. A qualifying live nameplate refuses a fresh bubble; a live bubble suppresses that unit's plate until recycled. Settings expose both CVars and default party bubbles on like Benilla. Build and focused clinical checks pass; live authenticated visual verification remains.

openItems.text: No overhead speech bubble for any chat kind: no bubble frame, no lifetime/fade law, no 20 yd gate, no bubble/nameplate mutual exclusion.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: ChatBubbleUiLaw and GameLoop.ChatBubbles implement the display-path kind gates, Blizzard backdrop/tail card, static Stand-box anchor, word-count lifetime, 250 ms fades, per-frame 20 yd gate, replacement, camera-distance stacking, and two-way nameplate exclusion.

openItems.text: Verify SAY/YELL/PARTY and monster bubbles in an authenticated live session: exact Background/Backdrop/Tail appearance, wrapped color text, static Stand-box seat, self/other lifetime, 20 yd recoverable fade, replacement, nearest-card stacking, and nameplate mutual exclusion.
